entries.claim: The previous baseline nonreport contrast separates S from C but not S from H.
entries.argument: Direct substitution: all z match; u_S=u_H!=u_C for beta!=0.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Only the declared three routes; no actual system.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Shows why a mediator intervention is needed.

entries.claim: The source-perturbation plus mediator-clamp signature separates S,C,H.
entries.argument: Displayed algebra in §4; 21 exact regressions include boundary values.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Off-target clamp, hidden paths or compensation invalidate application.

entries.claim: Finite route evidence does not imply unrestricted route closure when an untested gated bypass is admitted.
entries.domain: Finite W plus admitted x* extension.
all_premises: gate zero on W and one at x*
entries.argument: The added term vanishes on W and is nonzero at x*.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: A valid universal physical closure law can exclude the extension.

entries.claim: The three primary studies successively constrain criterion variants but do not provide the complete R174 mediator-clamp certificate.
entries.argument: Compare the reported evidence with each required route premise.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: No raw-data reanalysis; Cai scope is abstract; full studies may constrain more models.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Connects the model to a real evidence ladder without overclaiming.

entries.claim: A grounded actual Theta_STC relation has an experiential structural counterpart.
entries.argument: Ordinary isomorphism preservation for the grounded K-formula.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Does not name experienced order or validate C1.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Places the positive coordinate inside experience.

entries.claim: The evidence ladder and structural counterpart do not entail B_order.
entries.argument: No premise supplies the external relation-to-content interpretation; explicit failure conditions remain.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: A future independently justified narrower bridge is not ruled out.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Prevents report or control from defining experience.
